name: Fatima Institute for Global AI Research
bullets: Master’s thesis on curiosity-driven LLM exploration across inference, SFT, and GRPO, testing surprisal, learning progress, and information gain as curiosity signals.
Auditing multilingual specification-following with Tasmiah Tahsin Mayeesha (UNT) and Md Kishor Morol (Anthropic).

name: PRISM AI Safety Research Fellowship
bullets: Reproduced Meta’s LoRe and helped fix a data shortcut that had inflated its accuracy from 59% to 93%.
Developed Reward Basis Decomposition (RBD), finding that most personalization gains come from shared preferences.
Co-first author of a NeurIPS 2026 InterpScience workshop oral (1 of 4 from 267 submissions).

name: MIT AI Alignment
bullets: Studied alignment, scalable oversight, and mechanistic interpretability.
Weekly reading groups on reward misspecification, alignment faking, and AI threat models.

name: Medical Informatics & Neuro Dynamics (MIND) School
bullets: Developed deep learning models for EEG-based seizure detection, co-authoring a paper in Knowledge-Based Systems.
Studied sycophancy in medical vision-language models, leading to a co-first-authored NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper.

name: Université Paris-Est Créteil
bullets: Built an LLM-based event discovery system with TinyLlama 1.1B over 50K+ records from 100+ sources.
Applied ensemble knowledge distillation using Jais 13B, Gemma 3, and TunBERT.
